jobs.title: Physician Executive/CEO - Temple Faculty Physicians
jobs.description:
Chief Executive Officer, Temple Faculty Physicians

Temple University Health System

Philadelphia, PA
Full-time
Executive
On-site

The Opportunity

Temple University Health System is seeking a physician executive to serve as Chief Executive Officer of Temple Faculty Physicians (TFP)
— the multispecialty academic practice plan through which Temple's clinical faculty deliver care across Temple Health.

The CEO is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of TFP and partners closely with the Lewis Katz School of Medicine.

About Temple Faculty Physicians

800+ physicians and advanced practice providers across the full range of medical and surgical specialties
Care delivered at Temple University Hospital, Fox Chase Cancer Center, Jeanes Campus, Episcopal Campus, Chestnut Hill Hospital, and ambulatory sites throughout the Philadelphia region
Physicians are dually employed by TFP and the Lewis Katz School of Medicine (LKSOM), holding faculty appointments while practicing through TFP
A payer mix and acuity profile that demand disciplined, creative physician enterprise leadership — and make that leadership matter

Position Summary

Reporting directly to the President & CEO of Temple University Health System
, the CEO is accountable for TFP's strategic, operational, financial, and cultural performance — clinical operations, financial results, provider compensation and workforce strategy, quality and access, and compliance.

A successful leader in this role is experienced in leading through influence and building effective partnerships with the medical school, department chairs, operational leaders, and all parts of the integrated health system.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Develop a multi-year strategy for TFP aligned with the TUHS strategic plan and LKSOM's academic priorities
Integrate practice plan operations — payer contracting, revenue cycle, access, care standards, shared services — into the broader clinical enterprise while preserving departmental identity
Partner with system leadership on ambulatory growth, network development, service lines, and physician-facing capital investment

Academic Partnership and Governance

Establish a structured, trusted working relationship with the Dean of LKSOM, including a clear framework for joint decisions on funds flow, recruitment, effort allocation, and chair searches
Serve as the principal executive partner to clinical department chairs and co-lead the Council of Chairs
Staff the TFP board and keep governance structures current and effective

Financial Performance

Lead TFP's operating budget, multi-year financial plan, and results
Design and administer a transparent, defensible academic funds flow model
Drive revenue cycle performance and partner on payer strategy, including value-based and risk-bearing arrangements
Build provider- and department-level analytics on productivity, margin, access, and cost

Provider Recruitment, Engagement, and Retention

Oversee physician recruitment strategy jointly with chairs and the Dean's office
Champion faculty wellness, development, and retention
Make the practice plan transparent and legible to the physicians it serves
Build the next generation of physician leaders

Quality, Access, And Patient Experience

Set and achieve access targets — new patient availability, third-next-available, referral capture, continuity
Align TFP incentives to system quality and population health goals
Own patient experience performance across TFP sites
Sponsor ambulatory EHR and digital access strategy: scheduling, telehealth, messaging, provider efficiency

Operations and Organizational Development

Standardize ambulatory operations — staffing, templates, site management — where it improves performance
Develop a TFP leadership team with clear accountability and succession depth
Establish a disciplined operating rhythm with transparent scorecards and closed-loop follow-through

Qualifications

Required

MD or DO from an accredited medical or osteopathic medical school
Progressive executive leadership in a large multispecialty physician group, academic practice plan, or integrated physician enterprise, including P&L accountability
A track record of leading operational and financial improvement, integration, or large-scale change in a complex, matrixed environment
Substantive experience partnering with medical school leadership and clinical department chairs

Preferred

MBA or equivalent business credential
Experience in an academic health system serving a complex urban or safety-net population
Experience with value-based and risk-bearing contracting
Experience leading through governance transition, employment consolidation, or practice plan restructuring
Experience negotiating and administering funds flow between separately governed academic and clinical entities

About Temple Health

Temple Health is an academic health system with a deeply rooted mission: exceptional care for a community that needs it, education of the next generation of clinicians, and research that moves medicine forward. The people who thrive here are drawn to hard problems and the belief that disciplined, humane leadership changes outcomes for patients and providers alike. As CEO of TFP, you will have the platform, the partnership, and the mandate to do exactly that.

jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.description:
Company Profile
Nayan Media Works is preparing to establish a U.S. subsidiary focused on blockchain technology, digital asset infrastructure, fintech, enterprise payment solutions, and secure digital platforms.
The subsidiary is currently in the formation and compliance planning stage. We are assembling a founding executive team to lead its entry into the U.S. market, organizational development, product strategy formulation, partnership building, and long-term growth.
Position Overview
We are seeking an entrepreneurial Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to establish and lead this new U.S. blockchain subsidiary.
The CEO will report to the parent company and the Board of Directors, responsible for formulating business strategy, establishing operational systems, recruiting the leadership team, managing budgets, developing strategic partnerships, and guiding the company through formation and compliance preparations.
This is a hands-on founding leadership role requiring keen business acumen, rigorous operational management capabilities, and experience in building early-stage technology or financial services companies.
Key Responsibilities
Formulate and execute the subsidiary’s U.S. business and market entry strategy.
Lead company formation, operational planning, corporate governance, and compliance preparations.
Build the founding leadership team as well as technical, operational, compliance, and commercial teams.
Oversee product strategy in the fields of blockchain infrastructure, digital assets, fintech, and enterprise payments.
Establish budgets, financial controls, performance targets, and reporting systems.
Build relationships with technology providers, financial institutions, enterprise clients, and strategic partners.
Evaluate business opportunities, joint ventures, and potential acquisitions.
Collaborate with legal and compliance advisors to define licensing applications and regulatory compliance requirements.
Report operational plans, financial forecasts, risk profiles, and performance reports to the Board of Directors.
Establish a corporate culture focused on accountability, innovation, security, and business ethics.
Qualifications
12+ years of executive experience in blockchain, fintech, financial services, enterprise technology, or related fields. Previous roles such as CEO, President, Managing Director, COO, or senior business unit head.
Proven track record in launching, scaling, or transforming business ventures.
Deep understanding of blockchain technology, digital assets, financial infrastructure, cybersecurity, and risk management. Experienced in fundraising, budget management, partnership development, team building, and reporting to the Board of Directors.
Familiar with U.S. regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements within the financial services industry.
Possesses exceptional leadership, negotiation, communication, and decision-making skills.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
We offer:
A Founding CEO role with significant authority over strategic and operational decisions.
Opportunities to collaborate directly with the parent company and the Board of Directors.
Highly competitive executive compensation commensurate with experience.
Performance-based incentives and potential equity participation opportunities.
Hybrid work model and company-supported business travel arrangements.
The opportunity to build a U.S.-based blockchain company from the ground up.
Regulatory Statement
This U.S. subsidiary is currently in the formation stage and is subject to necessary corporate and regulatory approvals. Until all required licenses and approvals are obtained, the company will not provide services such as banking, securities brokerage, investment advisory, money transmission, digital asset trading, or custody of client assets.
Nayan Media Works is an equal opportunity employer

jobs.title: Regional Director Of Operations
jobs.description:
Regional Director of Operations

Our Culture

We are a highly entrepreneurial company limited only by our imagination. Diversity and teamwork are major aspects of our culture. Our property associates are a highly team-focused group bringing out the uniqueness of each associate to provide great products and services. Success comes to those who continuously seek opportunities to learn and pass on new knowledge. We always strive to be better, never bored, and never complacent. Our teams thrive on hard work, inclusivity, and producing outstanding experiences. We endeavor to make our fellow associates feel comfortable and entrepreneurial so that they can engage unhindered. Finally, giving back to the community is also vital to our culture. Our properties live by the philosophy that they are an important part of their communities and look for ways to partner in the local community to make a difference.

Job Description

The Regional Director of Operations is responsible for overall operational excellence for the properties in their area and will be a leader who exemplifies and embodies our Culture. This role will support all disciplines to deliver outstanding results, lead strategic initiatives, drive associate development, and work with the team to maximize revenues and grow profit across our portfolio. This leader will work with a remarkable group of associates who insist you are highly communicative, dedicated, balanced, and collaborative. The person in this position must be able to roll their sleeves up and assist our teams when needed, living our “ONE TEAM. ONE VISION.” philosophy. This person must also provide innovative strategic strategies that align with our mission to be the best, most respected hotel company in America.

The Job Is Simple

Focus on ways to promote and engage in internal growth programs.

Continuously exemplify and live by our Culture.

Meet/exceed our company goals and three metrics.

Job Requirements

Work jointly with other company leaders to ensure that key objectives are met.
Work with all senior leaders to ensure we are leading in associate engagement and loyalty, produce top brand performance in guest satisfaction, deliver accurate forecasts that meet and exceed financial performance.
Have oversight of and mentor highly engaged and top-performing area General Managers to support Associates, Sales, Revenue, Engineering, Food & Beverage, and Operations.
Coach and mentor all leaders to help them reach their full potential; establish clear expectations in their role.
Regularly hold and actively participate in meetings with the properties' Leadership teams to review performance and analyze data and industry trends to improve processes and procedures.
Work with leadership on property capital improvements and budget oversite.
Conduct monthly property visits to review all aspects of the operation and serve as a cultural ambassador of our core values to all associates.
Work closely with sales & marketing and revenue management to help achieve and exceed RevPAR goals.
Work with all areas of the leadership teams taking time to understand our programs and how programs or practices affect our operations and culture; be the catalyst to prevent any working silos.
Be transparent with all stakeholders, taking the time to understand everyone's responsibilities and how to best partner with the individuals to determine field subject matter experts, celebrate our culture, and seek feedback while holding everyone accountable.
Establish regular communication with the field teams to understand their needs, support property initiatives and ensure we are the community's living room.

Necessary Skills

Has the highest degree of integrity and is humble, living by the Golden Rule
Approachable and easily engage in general conversation to build rapport quickly, outstanding interpersonal skills for a wide range of audiences
Must have exceptional organization, follow-through, and excellent communication skills.
Must have a proven record of the ability to lead others at all levels of the operations, develop leaders and teams successfully, hold everyone accountable, and produce a unified team
Demonstrated success in owner relations within a variety of situations and a track record in achieving results
Minimum of three (3) years in a Multi-Property operational oversight role within upper midscale, lifestyle, or luxury hospitality companies- preferred
Willingness to travel +/- 80% of the time or when needed; travel will ebb and flow with the needs of the business.
Approaches all items with a collaborative effort; values input, and experiences of others look to uncover all areas that need to be addressed to remove any barriers.
Passionate for best-in-class results; comfortable in being “the” decision maker when needed yet can “allow” others to take the lead when needed.
Prioritizes and organizes work, being adaptable and flexible to accommodate when needed
Has a track record of maintaining confidentiality and knows how to use discretion when appropriate; understands the difference between transparency and confidentiality
Able to work with people from diverse cultures and backgrounds
Values of dedication, innovation, showing respect, being driven by excellence, being community-focused, and having a spirit of service.

Vision Hospitality Group is an equal opportunity/AA/Disability/Veteran employer. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Vision Hospitality Group celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an equitable and inclusive environment and a sense of belonging for all associates. We do not discriminate and believe everybody should be proud of who they are, represent their culture and heritage, and live by the Golden Rule.

Optional Company paid Life Insurance
401(k) and 401(k) matching
Employee Assistance Program
Several Voluntary and Supplemental Insurance Options

jobs.title: Program Director
jobs.description:
Position Title: Program Director
Organization: Ripple 2 Wave Foundation
Location: Dependent on City/State
Status: Volunteer (2-3 hours/week)

About Ripple 2 Wave Foundation:

Ripple 2 Wave Foundation is a purpose-driven nonprofit organization committed to making
meaningful impact across communities. Through a diverse portfolio of outreach programs,
including youth empowerment, environmental projects, senior and veteran support, animal
advocacy, and homelessness outreach, we strive to transform compassion into measurable
change.

Position Overview
The Program Director is a volunteer leadership position responsible for turning ideas,
opportunities, and community needs into meaningful, actionable programs for Ripple 2 Wave
Foundation.
Working closely with the Steering Committee and Executive Team, the Program Director
serves as the bridge between concept and community impact. This role helps volunteers
develop ideas into structured program proposals, presents recommendations to leadership
for approval, and coordinates approved initiatives through implementation, evaluation, and
improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Work with Steering Committee volunteers to identify and develop new program ideas.
Transform community needs and volunteer ideas into practical, mission-aligned
programs.
Develop program proposals that outline goals, activities, timelines, resources,
partnerships, and anticipated outcomes.
Collaborate with volunteers and community partners to research, strengthen, and refine
proposed initiatives.
Present program proposals and recommendations to the Executive Team for review and
approval.
Incorporate leadership feedback and guide approved programs from concept through
implementation.
Coordinate volunteers, schedules, logistics, resources, and community partnerships for
approved programs.
Monitor program progress, participation, and outcomes.
Provide regular updates to the Executive Team regarding program development and
implementation.
Evaluate completed and ongoing programs and recommend improvements, expansion, or
new opportunities.
Maintain organized program documentation, calendars, timelines, and related records.
Represent Ripple 2 Wave Foundation professionally when working with volunteers,
partners, and the broader community.

Leadership Expectations

The Program Director should be a proactive, collaborative leader who can:
Turn broad ideas into clear, organized, and actionable plans.
Build consensus and work effectively with volunteers from diverse backgrounds.
Communicate clearly with both the Steering Committee and Executive Team.
Take ownership of projects while recognizing when leadership approval is required.
Keep projects organized, moving forward, and aligned with the Foundation's mission.
Follow through on commitments and communicate challenges or delays promptly.
Lead with professionalism, creativity, accountability, and respect.

Qualifications

Commitment to Ripple 2 Wave Foundation's mission and values.
Strong organizational, communication, and project-management skills.
Ability to develop ideas into practical programs and compelling proposals.
Confidence presenting ideas and recommendations to organizational leadership.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with volunteers and
partners.
Previous nonprofit, volunteer leadership, program development, or community
engagement experience is preferred but not required.

Volunteer Commitment

This is a volunteer leadership position. The expected time commitment is approximately 2-3
hours per week, depending on active programs, project timelines, and organizational needs.
The Program Director does not independently commit the Foundation to new programs,
expenditures, partnerships, contracts, or other significant organizational obligations without
appropriate Executive Team approval.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing and Communications
jobs.description:
Employment Status: Full-time/Exempt

Compensation: $90,000 – $110,000

Reports to: Assistant Head of School for Institutional Advancement & Enrollment

About Us

A Pike education ignites a lifelong journey of discovery.

The Pike School is a premier PreK-9 independent school located in Andover, MA serving 395 students in PreK-Grade 9. Our community is rooted in our values of Authenticity, Intellectual Ambition and Social Good, encouraging students to be empowered learners, change agents, and global citizens. We spark a lifelong journey of exploration and growth as we prepare students to think critically and have the confidence to take risks.

Position Summary

The Director of Marketing and Communications is a high-impact leadership role within the Institutional Advancement and Enrollment (IAE) team. This individual leads the strategy and execution of all internal and external communications to drive enrollment, support fundraising, and strengthen the school’s brand. Pike seeks an innovative, collaborative, and entrepreneurial leader who can translate the School’s distinctive strengths into compelling narratives that inspire prospective families, engage alumni and donors and strengthen community pride.

Marketing & Digital Strategy

Enrollment & Recruitment: Partner with Admission to build and execute multi-channel campaigns (digital ads, print collateral, recruitment drives) that highlight Pike to prospective families.
Digital Media & Advertising: Manage the daily operations and growth of the website (Finalsite) and social channels (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn); collaborate with external partners on digital advertising.
Reputation & Review Management: Maintain Pike’s profile across external school review sites (Google, Niche, GreatSchools etc.).
Event Marketing: Lead promotional strategy, digital assets, signage, and collateral for key institutional events (Commencement, One Pike Day, Centennial, and Auxiliary Programs).

Communications & Editorial

Messaging & Calendar: Maintain the master communications calendar to drive a consistent cadence for all internal (faculty, staff, parents) and external messaging.
Content Creation & Deployment: Write, edit, and publish schoolwide e-newsletters, website stories, social content, and leadership communications via platforms like Constant Contact.
Advancement & Alumni Messaging: Partner with Development and Alumni Relations to ensure donor and alumni outreach aligns with schoolwide messaging and voice.
Centennial Campaign: Execute the multi-year communications strategy for Pike’s 100th anniversary in 2026–2027 and beyond.

Operations, Brand & Visual Assets

Project Management: Coordinate incoming marcom requests and project timelines across departments to ensure accurate, on-time delivery.
Brand Governance: Enforce visual identity and editorial standards across all print, digital, and promotional merchandise.
Media & Asset Management: Manage digital asset libraries, schedule photography/videography vendors, handle media permissions, and cover evening/weekend events for content capture as needed.
Publication Management: Project manage the annual update, review cycle, and production of school handbooks, directory updates, and institutional documents across administrative departments.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required; degree in marketing, communications, journalism, public relations, English, or a related field preferred.
Four or more years of marketing or communications experience preferably within an independent school, higher education, nonprofit, or other mission-driven organization.
Outstanding writing, editing, verbal communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate institutional priorities into compelling messaging for a variety of audiences.
Experience managing websites and social media platforms; Experience with photography, videography, and digital asset management preferred.
Highly collaborative with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to build relationships across a diverse school community and work effectively with faculty, staff, students, families, alumni, trustees, and external partners.
This is a full-time, twelve-month position requiring occasional evening and weekend work in support of School events and institutional priorities.

To Apply, Candidates Should Submit The Following Information

Resume and cover letter describing your interest in the position with an overview of your background and experience.
Resumes will be reviewed on a rolling basis with an immediate start date this fall.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Creator Shadow Software Pvt. Ltd., based in India, is a trusted outsourcing partner for custom mobile and software development solutions serving global clients since 2010. The company has delivered 600+ projects to more than 100 clients worldwide, supported by a team of experienced and specialized developers. Creator Shadow focuses on web and application development ranging from simple sites to complex e-business platforms and social network services. The organization emphasizes exceptional quality, strong customer support, and results-driven solutions that enhance clients’ brands, online visibility, and profitability through effective design, integration, and search engine optimization.
Role Description
The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations and driving operational excellence across the company’s software and web development services. The COO will align business and operational strategies, lead cross-functional teams, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to quality standards. Key responsibilities include optimizing processes, managing resource allocation, overseeing financial performance and budgets, and implementing policies that support sustainable growth. The role will collaborate closely with the executive leadership team on business planning, performance metrics, risk management, and client satisfaction initiatives. The COO will also play a key role in mentoring managers, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, and supporting strategic partnerships and global expansion.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Business Planning skills, including strategic planning, goal setting, and performance tracking.
Candidates should possess solid Operations Management skills to optimize workflows, manage teams, and improve service delivery.
Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support informed decision-making.
Candidates should possess Finance and Budgeting skills to manage P&L, forecast costs and revenues, and allocate resources effectively.
Experience in software or IT services, particularly in outsourcing or global delivery environments, is highly beneficial.
Proven leadership experience in a senior operational role, with the ability to manage remote and cross-cultural teams.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, management, finance, or a related field is preferred.

new_jobs.description:
Position Title: Program Director
Organization: Ripple 2 Wave Foundation
Location: Dependent on City/State
Status: Volunteer (2-3 hours/week)

About Ripple 2 Wave Foundation:

Ripple 2 Wave Foundation is a purpose-driven nonprofit organization committed to making
meaningful impact across communities. Through a diverse portfolio of outreach programs,
including youth empowerment, environmental projects, senior and veteran support, animal
advocacy, and homelessness outreach, we strive to transform compassion into measurable
change.

Position Overview
The Program Director is a volunteer leadership position responsible for turning ideas,
opportunities, and community needs into meaningful, actionable programs for Ripple 2 Wave
Foundation.
Working closely with the Steering Committee and Executive Team, the Program Director
serves as the bridge between concept and community impact. This role helps volunteers
develop ideas into structured program proposals, presents recommendations to leadership
for approval, and coordinates approved initiatives through implementation, evaluation, and
improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Work with Steering Committee volunteers to identify and develop new program ideas.
Transform community needs and volunteer ideas into practical, mission-aligned
programs.
Develop program proposals that outline goals, activities, timelines, resources,
partnerships, and anticipated outcomes.
Collaborate with volunteers and community partners to research, strengthen, and refine
proposed initiatives.
Present program proposals and recommendations to the Executive Team for review and
approval.
Incorporate leadership feedback and guide approved programs from concept through
implementation.
Coordinate volunteers, schedules, logistics, resources, and community partnerships for
approved programs.
Monitor program progress, participation, and outcomes.
Provide regular updates to the Executive Team regarding program development and
implementation.
Evaluate completed and ongoing programs and recommend improvements, expansion, or
new opportunities.
Maintain organized program documentation, calendars, timelines, and related records.
Represent Ripple 2 Wave Foundation professionally when working with volunteers,
partners, and the broader community.

Leadership Expectations

The Program Director should be a proactive, collaborative leader who can:
Turn broad ideas into clear, organized, and actionable plans.
Build consensus and work effectively with volunteers from diverse backgrounds.
Communicate clearly with both the Steering Committee and Executive Team.
Take ownership of projects while recognizing when leadership approval is required.
Keep projects organized, moving forward, and aligned with the Foundation's mission.
Follow through on commitments and communicate challenges or delays promptly.
Lead with professionalism, creativity, accountability, and respect.

Qualifications

Commitment to Ripple 2 Wave Foundation's mission and values.
Strong organizational, communication, and project-management skills.
Ability to develop ideas into practical programs and compelling proposals.
Confidence presenting ideas and recommendations to organizational leadership.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with volunteers and
partners.
Previous nonprofit, volunteer leadership, program development, or community
engagement experience is preferred but not required.

Volunteer Commitment

This is a volunteer leadership position. The expected time commitment is approximately 2-3
hours per week, depending on active programs, project timelines, and organizational needs.
The Program Director does not independently commit the Foundation to new programs,
expenditures, partnerships, contracts, or other significant organizational obligations without
appropriate Executive Team approval.

About Us

A Pike education ignites a lifelong journey of discovery.

The Pike School is a premier PreK-9 independent school located in Andover, MA serving 395 students in PreK-Grade 9. Our community is rooted in our values of Authenticity, Intellectual Ambition and Social Good, encouraging students to be empowered learners, change agents, and global citizens. We spark a lifelong journey of exploration and growth as we prepare students to think critically and have the confidence to take risks.

Position Summary

The Director of Marketing and Communications is a high-impact leadership role within the Institutional Advancement and Enrollment (IAE) team. This individual leads the strategy and execution of all internal and external communications to drive enrollment, support fundraising, and strengthen the school’s brand. Pike seeks an innovative, collaborative, and entrepreneurial leader who can translate the School’s distinctive strengths into compelling narratives that inspire prospective families, engage alumni and donors and strengthen community pride.

Marketing & Digital Strategy

Enrollment & Recruitment: Partner with Admission to build and execute multi-channel campaigns (digital ads, print collateral, recruitment drives) that highlight Pike to prospective families.
Digital Media & Advertising: Manage the daily operations and growth of the website (Finalsite) and social channels (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn); collaborate with external partners on digital advertising.
Reputation & Review Management: Maintain Pike’s profile across external school review sites (Google, Niche, GreatSchools etc.).
Event Marketing: Lead promotional strategy, digital assets, signage, and collateral for key institutional events (Commencement, One Pike Day, Centennial, and Auxiliary Programs).

Communications & Editorial

Messaging & Calendar: Maintain the master communications calendar to drive a consistent cadence for all internal (faculty, staff, parents) and external messaging.
Content Creation & Deployment: Write, edit, and publish schoolwide e-newsletters, website stories, social content, and leadership communications via platforms like Constant Contact.
Advancement & Alumni Messaging: Partner with Development and Alumni Relations to ensure donor and alumni outreach aligns with schoolwide messaging and voice.
Centennial Campaign: Execute the multi-year communications strategy for Pike’s 100th anniversary in 2026–2027 and beyond.

Operations, Brand & Visual Assets

Project Management: Coordinate incoming marcom requests and project timelines across departments to ensure accurate, on-time delivery.
Brand Governance: Enforce visual identity and editorial standards across all print, digital, and promotional merchandise.
Media & Asset Management: Manage digital asset libraries, schedule photography/videography vendors, handle media permissions, and cover evening/weekend events for content capture as needed.
Publication Management: Project manage the annual update, review cycle, and production of school handbooks, directory updates, and institutional documents across administrative departments.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required; degree in marketing, communications, journalism, public relations, English, or a related field preferred.
Four or more years of marketing or communications experience preferably within an independent school, higher education, nonprofit, or other mission-driven organization.
Outstanding writing, editing, verbal communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate institutional priorities into compelling messaging for a variety of audiences.
Experience managing websites and social media platforms; Experience with photography, videography, and digital asset management preferred.
Highly collaborative with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to build relationships across a diverse school community and work effectively with faculty, staff, students, families, alumni, trustees, and external partners.
This is a full-time, twelve-month position requiring occasional evening and weekend work in support of School events and institutional priorities.

To Apply, Candidates Should Submit The Following Information

Resume and cover letter describing your interest in the position with an overview of your background and experience.
Resumes will be reviewed on a rolling basis with an immediate start date this fall.

Company Description
Creator Shadow Software Pvt. Ltd., based in India, is a trusted outsourcing partner for custom mobile and software development solutions serving global clients since 2010. The company has delivered 600+ projects to more than 100 clients worldwide, supported by a team of experienced and specialized developers. Creator Shadow focuses on web and application development ranging from simple sites to complex e-business platforms and social network services. The organization emphasizes exceptional quality, strong customer support, and results-driven solutions that enhance clients’ brands, online visibility, and profitability through effective design, integration, and search engine optimization.
Role Description
The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations and driving operational excellence across the company’s software and web development services. The COO will align business and operational strategies, lead cross-functional teams, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to quality standards. Key responsibilities include optimizing processes, managing resource allocation, overseeing financial performance and budgets, and implementing policies that support sustainable growth. The role will collaborate closely with the executive leadership team on business planning, performance metrics, risk management, and client satisfaction initiatives. The COO will also play a key role in mentoring managers, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, and supporting strategic partnerships and global expansion.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Business Planning skills, including strategic planning, goal setting, and performance tracking.
Candidates should possess solid Operations Management skills to optimize workflows, manage teams, and improve service delivery.
Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support informed decision-making.
Candidates should possess Finance and Budgeting skills to manage P&L, forecast costs and revenues, and allocate resources effectively.
Experience in software or IT services, particularly in outsourcing or global delivery environments, is highly beneficial.
Proven leadership experience in a senior operational role, with the ability to manage remote and cross-cultural teams.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, management, finance, or a related field is preferred.
